method: WCAG relative luminance from delivered CSS tokens. TitleScreen declares color var(--wax-text) and version background var(--wood-dark).
rules: .title-screen { box-sizing: border-box; position: relative; isolation: isolate; min-height: 100dvh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 32px; background: var(--wood-dark); color: var(--wax-text); overflow: clip; }
p { overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .version { position: relative; text-align: right; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 0; background: var(--wood-dark); }
